name: @polymorfa/cli
description: The official command-line interface for Polymorfa

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node --test scripts/cli-reference.test.mjs && node scripts/cli-reference.mjs --check && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts && npm run audit:prod

audience.description: Manage campaign audiences and their members.

audience:members.description: Add, list, and remove audience members.

business.description: Manage Linked Device Business App resources.

business:accounts.description: Inspect linked business accounts and ad identities.

business:catalog.description: Inspect and manage the connected account catalog.

business:catalog:cart.description: Manage the business catalog cart setting.

business:order.description: Look up business orders from event tokens.

business:profile.description: Inspect and manage the account business profile.

business:profile:cover.description: Manage the business profile cover photo.

call.description: Reject incoming calls through the Linked Device session route.

calls.description: Place and manage calls, check consent, carry audio, and report on past calls.

calls:link.description: Create and preview WhatsApp call links.

calls:permission.description: Inspect and request call permission on Cloud API numbers.

calls:policy.description: Inspect and replace the team call policy.

calls:retention.description: Inspect and change how long Polymorfa keeps your team's call data.

calls:settings.description: Inspect and replace session call settings.

channel:message.description: Inspect and act on channel messages.

chat.description: Read stored chats on enrolled HMS Numbers (beta).

chat:message.description: Read stored messages on enrolled HMS Numbers (beta).

contact.description: Inspect contacts and manage the contact blocklist.

customer.description: Manage project Customers, pairing links, and assigned Numbers.

customer:pairing-link.description: Create, inspect, and revoke Customer pairing links.

event.description: Inspect and replay durable developer events.

group:participants.description: List and change group participants and admins.

identity.description: Resolve phone numbers and usernames to Polymorfa user IDs.

key.description: Inspect and revoke organization API keys.

label.description: Manage Messaging labels and chat assignments.

label:chat.description: Manage the complete label set assigned to a chat.

logs.description: Read and follow a project's API request log.

media.description: Inspect, download, and persist Messaging media.

message.description: Send messages and perform message actions.

message:send.description: Send a message by content type.

optout:settings.description: Inspect and replace STOP/START keyword capture.

presence.description: View and manage Messaging presence state.

presence:chat.description: View and renew policy-governed chat presence observations.

privacy.description: View and manage account-level Messaging privacy.

profile.description: View and manage the connected account profile.

profile:name.description: Manage the connected account profile name.

profile:picture.description: Manage the connected account profile picture.

profile:status.description: Manage the connected account profile status.

project.description: Select, list, and inspect the project context.

quicklink.description: Create, inspect, and cancel persistent onboarding QuickLinks.

security-incident.description: Inspect and acknowledge organization security incidents.

voice.description: Voice Automation (beta): audio library and text-to-speech provider credentials.

voice:audio.description: Upload, synthesize, inspect, preview, and delete library audio (beta).

voice:credential.description: Store, check, and delete your text-to-speech provider keys (beta).

session:configuration.description: Inspect and update inherited session configuration.

session:tier.description: Quote, confirm, and follow Number tier changes, including Hybrid Link choices.

sip-trunk.description: Connect a PBX to WhatsApp calls with SIP trunks.

user.description: Inspect Linked Device user identity data.

webhook:delivery.description: Inspect webhook deliveries and request explicit retries.

widget.description: Inspect and update saved QuickLink widget settings.

function.description: Manage project Functions and pinned deployments.

function:deployment.description: Build and promote immutable Function deployments.

function:secret.description: Create and revoke write-only Function secret versions.

function:invocation.description: Invoke Functions once and inspect metadata receipts.

cloud.description: Official API Number operations (beta). Team enrollment and scopes apply.

cloud:template.description: Manage Meta templates, separate from Polymorfa project drafts.

template.description: Submit saved project templates for approval.

cloud:credentials.description: Read redacted credential health and create guided reauthorization links.

flow.description: Manage project Flow drafts and their Official API lifecycle.

flow:key.description: Read and register phone-scoped Flow encryption public keys.

cloud:catalog.description: Read Meta product catalogs visible to a WhatsApp Business Account.

cloud:group.description: Manage WhatsApp groups on an Official API Number (beta). Requires an Official Business Account.

cloud:group:join-requests.description: Review join requests for Official groups that require approval.

analytics.description: Read WhatsApp number activity and operational vitals.

agent.description: Set up coding agents with the Polymorfa agent kit.
